qualification.education_qualification: Active membership in Bar Association/Sub-divisional Bar Association Sherghati with over 3 years of legal practice experience
qualification.details: Must possess good character and be physically and mentally sound. Must not have any registered or pending criminal case, must not have been convicted in any criminal case, and must not have been barred from holding any responsible office by a competent court or authority. Must hold membership certificate from the Bihar State Bar Council and District Bar Association / Sub-divisional Bar Association.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://gaya.dcourts.gov.in or the notice board of the civil court, Gaya to download the application form format.
Fill out the application form carefully with all required personal and professional details.
Attach self-attested passport-size photographs and required enclosures, including your Bihar State Bar Council and Bar Association membership certificate.
Attach an affidavit if applicable detailing any criminal record status as required under terms.

Submit the completed application form by hand at the office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Gaya (located at Old Commissioner Building, near Guest House, Gaya, Pin - 823001) or to the Secretary, Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee at the Sub-divisional Civil Court, Sherghati.
Ensure the application is handed over on any working day between 15 October 2026 and 5 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gaya Panel Lawyer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Must possess good character and be physically and mentally sound. Must not have any registered or pending criminal case, must not have been convicted in any criminal case, and must not have been barred from holding any responsible office by a competent court or authority. Must hold membership certificate from the Bihar State Bar Council and District Bar Association / Sub-divisional Bar Association.

rows.qualification_required: Must be a citizen of India and a resident of Gaya, an active member of the Bar Association / Sub-divisional Bar Association Sherghati, possess more than 3 years of experience in legal practice, and have an interest in legal service work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Gaya Panel Lawyer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at https://gaya.dcourts.gov.in or the notice board of the civil court, Gaya to download the application form format. Fill out the application form carefully with all required personal and professional details. Attach self-attested passport-size photographs and required enclosures, including your Bihar State Bar Council and Bar Association membership certificate. Attach an affidavit if applicable detailing any criminal record status as required under terms. Submit the completed application form by hand at the office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Gaya (located at Old Commissioner Building, near Guest House, Gaya, Pin - 823001) or to the Secretary, Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee at the Sub-divisional Civil Court, Sherghati. Ensure the application is handed over on any working day between 15 October 2026 and 5 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under Advt 02/2024?
faq.answer: A total of 55 vacancies are announced, comprising 30 for DLSA Gaya and 25 for the Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee, Sherghati.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 5 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the panel lawyer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have more than 3 years of experience in legal practice and active membership in the District Bar Association or Sub-divisional Bar Association Sherghati, alongside being a resident of Gaya and a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for DLSA Gaya Panel Lawyer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format from the official website and submit the filled form by hand at the office of the Secretary, DLSA Gaya, or at the Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee, Sherghati.

faq.question: Q6. Do candidates who applied under the previous notice need to re-apply?
faq.answer: No, advocates who have already submitted applications under the previously published advertisement number 02/2024 do not need to apply again.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the application form be submitted offline?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted by hand to the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Gaya (Old Commissioner Building, near Guest House, Gaya, Pin - 823001) or to the Secretary, Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee, Sherghati.
